cohort: 135 patients with confirmed PAS who underwent cesarean hysterectomy between 2012 and 2022 at a PAS center of excellence.
finding: Increasing episodes of antenatal vaginal bleeding in the setting of PAS were associated with increased emergent deliveries, earlier gestational ages at delivery, and increased maternal composite morbidity.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery differed between groups (33 weeks for those with 2 or more bleeding episodes vs. 34 weeks for those with 1 episode vs. 35 weeks for those with no bleeding)
